summary: Frontend-only verification of Flock Forecast tab changes in BBM app. Verified: (1) standalone '🎯 Accuracy' tab is removed from nav, (2) Batch Accuracy section now renders at the bottom of the Flock Forecast tab, (3) expanded shed-group cards render the enriched empty-state forecast card for sheds with no weigh-ins (Birds Placed / Mortality So Far / Current Age strip + Ross 308 standard-curve preview chart with current-day marker + 'First weigh-in check recommended ~Day 7' hint), (4) no NaN / undefined text rendered, and (5) farm switch to north-creek still shows correct farm name (regression sanity). All 3 targeted features pass.

issues: Minor: Birds Placed stat renders '—' when placement=0 rather than '0' (graceful fallback per spec, but numeric '0' + emphasized styling might read cleaner). Not a blocker.

critical_code_review_comments: App.tsx is a 13k-line monolith — long-standing tech debt flagged in prior iterations; consider splitting FlockForecastView, BatchAccuracyView-related helpers, and renderShedForecast into their own modules to keep files <700 lines.

Silo mini-section only renders when Silo Sync data exists (verified: absent for demo farm 'default' where no silo group data present) — behavior matches spec, but consider showing a neutral '🌾 Silo Sync not connected' hint so users know the feature exists.
